signal: Cirrus LED introduced an Efficiency Mode and AI-powered foot-traffic analytics for its outdoor digital signage, expanding its data-driven advertising story

email.subject1: a signal play for Cirrus LED
email.body1:
Dan, saw Cirrus LED leaning into the AI foot-traffic analytics and the new Efficiency Mode, sharpening the data-driven story behind the displays.

A stronger product narrative usually opens more buyers worth reaching than reps can personally cover, and good accounts stall while the team works the obvious fit. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Cirrus LED off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Dan, quick follow-up for Cirrus LED.

As the buyer set widens, named accounts per rep grow, and most teams cannot say how many meetings they actually need to hit the number. The gap shows up late, then the quarter becomes a recovery effort.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Cirrus LED needs to close that gap, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Dan, last bit of proof for Cirrus LED.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Cirrus LED's reply rate likely compares to similar B2B teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Dan, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling coverage without adding reps is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing matters, and a CRO's calendar rarely cooperates.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a hardware-plus-software motion? I will tailor it to Cirrus LED either way.
